requirements.name: Story Completion
requirements.note: GTABase lists this entry under its own Story heading instead of grouping it with Tasks.

requirements.name: Optional Tasks Completed
requirements.note: No fixed total is shown. Guides estimate a few hundred tasks exist, so missing some during the story is reported to be harmless.

requirements.name: Gang Operations Cleared
requirements.whereToCount: On the map, hovering a gang operation icon shows which valuables are still left there.

requirements.name: Bank Jobs Fully Completed
requirements.whereToCount: Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Bank Jobs.

requirements.name: Payday Loan Jobs Fully Completed
requirements.whereToCount: Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Payday Loans.

requirements.name: Stick Ups Fully Completed
requirements.whereToCount: Map > Robberies (money bag icon) > Stick Ups.

requirements.name: Narcotics Fenced
requirements.note: Every checklist source gives $100,000. One aside in PowerPyx's flamingo section mentions $200,000, which contradicts its own checklist table.

requirements.name: Vaults Hit
requirements.note: One vault per large bank; guides say these unlock in Chapter 4.

requirements.name: Kenton Sets Completed
requirements.whereToCount: Progress > Collections > Kenton's Treasures (also Progress > Characters > Kenton Rees).

requirements.name: WAiNK Locations Scanned
requirements.note: No source gives a total number of WAiNK locations.

requirements.name: Magazines, Books & Comics Found
requirements.whereToCount: Progress > Collections > Exploration. The menu gives a count only, not which titles you have read.
requirements.note: The 34 total is split as 27 magazines/books/comics plus 7 Book Swaps by PowerPyx's checklist, GTABase, and Timesaver. PowerPyx's dedicated magazine page lists 27 slots and gives no separate Book Swap count.

requirements.name: Cocaine Flamingos Destroyed
requirements.whereToCount: Progress > Collections > Exploration > Cocaine Flamingos; the row only appears once you have destroyed one.

requirements.name: Unique Playlists Completed
requirements.whereToCount: Progress > Collections > Exploration > Unique Playlists; the row only appears once you have found one.

requirements.name: Discovered Styles
requirements.note: The 79 total is reported as 13 + 15 character tattoos, 17 magazine tattoos, and 34 luxury watches.

requirements.name: Race Challenge Gold Medals
requirements.note: PowerPyx, KeenGamer, Press Start, and Timesaver give 10 of 13. Shacknews lists 42 and Push Square lists 30; both match the numbers on neighboring lines (Shooting Range 42, Unique Races 30), so they look like transcription slips, but the conflict is unresolved until someone checks the in-game list.

requirements.name: Shooting Range Gold Medals
requirements.note: GTABase splits the 42 as 18 at Griffin and 24 at Rodgers Ranch. PowerPyx's own range section quotes per-range medal figures (54 and 72) that do not match its checklist's 42.

requirements.name: Mini Golf Locations Played
requirements.whereToCount: Progress > Activities > Sports; hover each course to see whether it is done.

requirements.name: Drone Time Trials Completed
requirements.note: Reported as 14 locations with 3 trials each.

requirements.name: Stunts Completed
requirements.whereToCount: Progress > Activities > Stunts; R3 switches to a per-region breakdown.
requirements.note: The 397 total is reported as 130 Stunt Jumps, 202 Under the Bridges, 40 Knife Flights, and 25 Base Jumps.

requirements.name: Bret's Target Decks
requirements.note: HappyGamer files this under its crime/story group rather than Exploration & Activities.

requirements.name: Standard Issue Weapons
requirements.note: The 66 total is reported as 53 guns, 9 melee, and 4 explosives.

cardSets.name: Vice City Manatees
cardSets.note: GTADB notes that the detailed card list it worked from shows 30 slots for this set even though the overview says 24.

cardSets.name: Vice City Club De Fútbol
cardSets.note: Spelled without the accent ("Futbol") by Push Square, Game-Checklists, and GMTreks.

cardSets.name: Jack of Hearts Dancers
cardSets.note: Push Square's main list shortens it to "Jack of Hearts".

cardSets.name: Nine1Nine Dancers
cardSets.note: Push Square's main list shortens it to "Nine1Nine".

cardSets.name: The Legends of Ratface
cardSets.note: Game-Checklists and a PowerPyx sidebar write "The Legend of Ratface" (singular).

missables.label: Lucia's balcony meditation at the first safehouse
missables.where: Balcony of Jason's house in Key Lento; reported to appear partway through Chapter 1.
missables.effect: Missing it caps your meditation count at 17 of 18—spending 1 of your 3 spares, though 15 is still reachable. It may also lock out the separate all-meditations trophy.
missables.note: PowerPyx saw it add 1 to the counter but notes it is not marked like the other spots; whether the trophy needs it is unconfirmed.

missables.label: Victor Maravilla card (Los Santos Corkers)
missables.where: Starlet Motel, Gellhorn (Kelly County): on the kitchen fridge.
missables.effect: If no second copy exists, Los Santos Corkers can't be completed—leaving 17 completable sets (2 spares above the 15 needed).
missables.note: Location and wording match PowerPyx closely on the other sites, so this is treated as one origin. GTADB says it is unknown whether the card can be picked up later.

missables.label: Vicki card (Delights Dancers)
missables.where: Starlet Motel, Gellhorn (Kelly County): office bathroom floor beside the toilet.
missables.effect: If no second copy exists, Delights Dancers can't be completed. Losing both Starlet Motel sets leaves 16 completable sets (1 spare above the 15 needed).
missables.note: Same single-origin caveat as the Victor Maravilla card. The Harley card in the same set (inside Delights) is reported as still collectible later.

missables.label: Five reading items at the first safehouse: Ashes of Glory, Lethal By Design, Orca A Whole Different Animal, Off the Hook, Body Copy
missables.where: Jason's house in Key Lento: bedside table, living room tables, the tool shed underneath, and the back deck.
missables.effect: These copies are reported to disappear after Chapter 1. PowerPyx says most titles also exist elsewhere, but no second spot is confirmed for these 5; 30 of 34 are needed, leaving room to miss up to 4.
missables.note: Game-Checklists also lists magazines at this house as lost after Chapter 1 and says some issues appear elsewhere.

missables.label: Two reading items at the Starlet Motel: Help Me Help You Help Me, Wizard Wang
missables.where: Starlet Motel, Gellhorn: reception room table and cafeteria table.
missables.effect: These copies are reported to disappear after Chapter 2. Other locations may exist, but none are confirmed; any lost title eats into your 4-item skip margin (30 of 34 needed).

missables.label: Two reading items at the Bayside Apartment: Passion B.C., Two Pricks in the Bush
missables.where: Bayside Apartment, Vice City: beside the bathtub and on the table in front of the TV.
missables.effect: These copies are reported to disappear after Chapter 3. Other locations may exist, but none are confirmed; any lost title eats into your 4-item skip margin (30 of 34 needed).

pointsOfNoReturn.label: End of Chapter 1: the first safehouse becomes unavailable, along with its meditation spot and reading items. Cash on hand is reported lost too, so bank it first.
End of Chapter 2: the Starlet Motel rooms (2 cards, 2 reading items) become unavailable to enter.
End of Chapter 3: one apartment interior with two reading items is reported to close, and some fences may stop buying.
pointsOfNoReturn.note: PowerPyx marks two Bayside Apartment items as lost after Chapter 3 and Dork advises selling loot before the Chapter 3 finale, but Game-Checklists lists no lock at the end of Chapter 3.

pointsOfNoReturn.label: End of Chapter 4: reported as a major save point—missions can't be replayed and end-of-chapter choices are reported to be permanent, so keep a manual save.
Chapter 5 finale: story missions can't be replayed afterward. Free roam continues and remaining checklist requirements stay available.

exceptions.title: The checklist stays hidden until the story ends
exceptions.detail: The in-game list (Progress > Stats > 100% Completion) cannot be viewed before the credits, but anything done earlier still counts. Use the individual Progress menus to track counts in the meantime.

exceptions.title: Kenton needs 5 of 7, but Underwater Discoveries need all 7
exceptions.detail: The Kenton entry only asks for 5 of the 7 shipwreck sets, but all 33 Underwater Discoveries sit inside those wrecks and all 33 are required—so you'll end up doing all 7 sets anyway.

exceptions.title: 18 meditations come from only 10 spots
exceptions.detail: Guides report that 8 of the 10 spots can be done once as each lead character (2 meditations each). The first-safehouse balcony spot and a final mountain spot (reported to appear after the others) each count once. You need 15 of the 18.
exceptions.note: The per-spot breakdown comes from PowerPyx alone. Other guides only repeat "18 across 10 locations".

exceptions.title: Only base models count toward the 200
exceptions.detail: The vehicle database is reported to hold 557 entries: 277 base models plus 280 Standout variants parked at fixed spots. Guides report that only base models count toward the 200, including boats and aircraft.
exceptions.note: Timesaver says its vehicle counts come from PowerPyx, and GTABase repeats the same figures, so this is one origin.

exceptions.title: Selling cards does not undo progress
exceptions.detail: Cards sold at pawn shops stay marked as found in Collections, so selling them is safe. A display box at home reportedly shows only cards you still own.

exceptions.title: Color variants count separately; duplicates don't
exceptions.detail: Each color or metal variant of a card fills its own slot in a set. Picking up a second copy of the same variant adds nothing, though you can sell it. The 15 smallest sets total 372 cards.

exceptions.title: Trophy targets are not the checklist targets
exceptions.detail: Several trophies unlock at lower counts than 100% needs: 250 stunts (300 needed), 50 challenges (70), 20 race wins (30), and 3 card sets (15). The meditation trophy goes the other way—it wants all meditations, while the checklist accepts 15.

exceptions.title: Any mix of stunt types works
exceptions.detail: Guides report that Stunt Jumps, Under the Bridges, Knife Flights, and Base Jumps all feed the same 300 count. Doing each stunt once is reported to be enough—the optional challenges on each stunt icon aren't required.

exceptions.title: A store robbery may not count without its safe
exceptions.detail: Guides warn that skipping the backroom safe during a Smash 'N' Grab can leave that store not "fully completed".

exceptions.title: Each hoop counts once
exceptions.detail: Guides report that the 90 must be different hoops; scoring repeatedly at the same hoop doesn't add to your count.

exceptions.title: Par time only matters on two of three trials
exceptions.detail: Guides report that at each drone location, only the first 2 trials must beat par (28 runs total); the third only needs to be finished.

exceptions.title: Starting a game is enough
exceptions.detail: Guides report that each of the 4 video games only needs to be launched, not beaten.

exceptions.title: Full-size golf courses don't count
exceptions.detail: Guides report that only the 3 mini golf courses count toward this entry; the 2 regular golf courses are separate.

exceptions.title: Only one flamingo variant counts
exceptions.detail: Only flamingos with a black-and-white beak are reported to count toward the 125.
exceptions.note: EGamers attributes this to PowerPyx; treated as one origin.

exceptions.title: Holding a weapon once registers it
exceptions.detail: Guides report that a weapon logs as soon as you equip it once—no kills or purchases beyond that are needed.

exceptions.title: Binoculars are enough and breeds count separately
exceptions.detail: Guides report that studying an animal through binoculars logs it (no hunting required), and different dog and cat breeds each count as their own entry.

exceptions.title: Missed valuables take a long time to come back
exceptions.detail: Guides report that if you leave a gang operation with a valuable still inside, the site does respawn, but only after a long wait—clear it fully on the first visit.

exceptions.title: Some fences close during the story
exceptions.detail: Certain fences are reported to stop trading for good as the story advances, so sell stolen goods you are holding before chapter finales.
